name: cv-creator
description: Generates an ATS-friendly PDF resume from a markdown master file

scripts.cv: tsc && node dist/cli.js data/examples/cv-example-es.md --out out/CV_ES_example.pdf && node dist/cli.js data/examples/cv-example-en.md --out out/CV_EN_example.pdf
scripts.cv:tsx: tsx src/cli.ts data/examples/cv-example-es.md --out out/CV_ES_example.pdf && tsx src/cli.ts data/examples/cv-example-en.md --out out/CV_EN_example.pdf
scripts.cv:private: tsc && node dist/cli.js private/cv-master.md --out private/out/CV_ES.pdf && node dist/cli.js private/cv-master-en.md --out private/out/CV_EN.pdf

author: cv-creator contributors
